transcript.text: Urban wetlands hold stormwater after heavy rain, so less water enters drains at once. This is why wetland restoration has reduced flooding by 80% in every Indian city where it has been attempted. Municipalities should concrete all wetland beds to stop seepage, build retaining walls and prohibit any human entry. Regular desilting and community monitoring can help protect the area. These measures will end urban floods.
